title: Higher integrability for parabolic double phase equations with an improved gap bound
summary: We prove a local higher integrability result for the gradient of Hölder continuous weak solutions to the parabolic double phase equation \[ \partial_t u - \operatorname{div} \left(|Du|^{p-2}Du + a(z)|Du|^{q-2}Du\right) = 0 \qquad \text{in } Ω_T. \] We work under a relaxed gap condition on the exponents $p$ and $q$. The coefficient $a$ is assumed to belong to the class $\mathcal{Z}^κ(Ω_T)$ for some $κ\in (0,\infty)$.
